characters.name: In General
characters.description: Adaptation Distillation: The anime cut out most of the Union Teope parts, replacing it with the small drug cartel Red Pegasus to kill off Hideyuki. The filmAngel Dusteventually reveals that Red Pegasus was in fact Union Teope's Japanese proxy. The Dreaded: Even other criminal organizations areterrifiedof the Union, and with good reasons. In fact, Ryo's reputation asThe Dreadedstems fromkicking Union Teope out of Japan when they first tried to expand there. Laser-Guided Karma: A good chunk of the money Ryo stole from them was given to the rehabilitation clinic where Ryo had sent a few dozens of women they had addicted to drugs. Psycho Serum: Angel Dust make the victim stronger and near-immune to pain, resulting in them being practically unstoppable unless you behead or blow them up (they will be harmed by bullets, but will continue 'till they bleed out unless the bullet hits something vital). The victim will also obey any order, and the withdrawal is 99% lethal. The Syndicate: They are involved in drugs, prostitution, illegal gambling, jewelry theft (with the jewels sold in apparently legitimate shops owned by the Union), and probably more.

characters.name: Midori Nagumo
characters.description: The Ace: Was this back in high school. Her amazing prowess at sports was what initially drew Niikura to her. Now, without extracurricular activities to motivate hershe's fallen into a major rut. Brilliant, but Lazy: She was and in many ways still is an incredible athlete despite herCareer-Ending Injury, but due to a chronic lack of motivation, an addiction to betting on horse racing, and a constant lack of money owing to the former two, Nagumo is perpetually stuck in a rut of her own making. Career-Ending Injury: While she was an excellent athlete, her days of truly competing came to an end when she injured her knee in high school. The manga never explains how she got the injury in the first place, but whatever the case, it couldn't be cured and pain prevented her from trying for sports again. It went away after entering college, so it could have just been her straining herself from the sheer number of sports she did. Forgot to Pay the Bill: Her falling behind on her rent payments is what starts the series. Future Loser: Promising sports starlet in virtually every possible category as a teenager, gambling addict with no goals or ambitions besides the next thrill as a college student.

characters.name: Ayumu Niikura
characters.description: Ambiguously Gay: She was a big fan of Nagumo in high school, and she keeps a locket with Nagumo's picture on her at all times and doesn't want anyone else to know or see it. It's not clear if she's in love with Nagumo or simply admires her athletic abilities; Matsuri and Ecchan certainly think she's in love with Nagumo after discovering the locket, but Niikura herself has yet to confirm this. Camera Fiend: Over the course of the series, it becomes clear that Niikura is quite fond of the camera, whether it be taking photos or recording videos. None of her efforts to win photography contests bear fruit, but that doesn't stop her from trying anyway. Guilty Pleasure: She has a habit of eating uncooked prepackaged ramen right out of the bag, along with the soup stock, whenever she wants a midnight snack. She knows it's an embarrassing thing to do, but she can't help but enjoy it anyway. Never Lend to a Friend: Nagumo is perpetually asking her to loan her money, to the point that when Nagumo comes to her looking for a loan in the first chapter her first instinct is to run away before Nagumo can say anything. Only Sane Woman: Serves as theStraight Manwho is oftenEnraged by Idiocy" and reacts the most normally to the strange events, such as her best friend Midori Nagumo's reckless, debt-ridden schemes or other eccentric townsfolk.

characters.name: Wako Izumi
characters.description: The Chessmaster:The whole of the CITY Race, sheknewthat Nagumo wanted the million dollars (and could very well get it considering her athletics), but she wanted to have Matsuri and Ecchan win instead and concocted a plan to block her from the finish line. She planned everything, up to and including theparticipants of the race, just to grant the two a day to remember before Ecchan leaves for England. Cloud Cuckoo Lander: She's not really all there in the head. She's frequently distracted by odd trains of thought, prone to odd flights of fancy and worships a god she made up herself. The Fool: Seems to unwittingly stumble into good fortune at every turn. It Amused Me: Seemingly her sole motivation throughout the series. Plucky Girl: A perpetually cheerful young woman with little to no grasp on reality.

characters.name: Tsurubishi Makabe
characters.description: Aw, Look! They Really Do Love Each Other: When he thinks Dr. Adatara has died, he shows a moment of weakness and sincerity as he admits the only reason he and his friends picked on him so much was because he thought he was lonely, and even admits sometimes he might've taken it a bit too far. Hidden Depths: He admits that he truly did care for Dr. Adatara, despite targeting him for pranks all the time. Admitting this causes him to start crying. Jerkass: He quite enjoys making jokes at other people's expenses. The Prankster: He's fond of pulling pranks, usually on his son Tatewaku (who's already rather gullible and easily falls for his tricks) or Dr. Adatara (whom he has a long-standing prank war with).

characters.name: Mrs. Makabe
characters.description: Adventurer Archaeologist: Mrs. Makabe is a lot of things, but nothing moreso than a spirited traveler. She routinely brings home quirky yet valuable digs from her expeditions, and in the final initial run chapter reveals that she's discovered a wholecontinent. The Ghost: She never shows up in person throughout the first run of the manga. Her appearance is never shown either,up untilthe last chapter of the initial run, where the audience is treated to her head on a phone icon. She makes her first full-body appearance in Chapter 198/NewChapter 12.

characters.name: Tatewaku Makabe
characters.description: Butt-Monkey: Tends to be on the receiving end of an endless stream of humiliations and mishaps. First Love: Subverted. Ecchan once tells Matsuri that she thought she had a crush on Tatewaku, and that she likes him because his actions and reactions are entertaining. Matsuri walks her though her friend's feelings and makes her realize that those are more amusement than love, but both like him enough anyway. Hopeless Suitor: Like the rest of the male population, for Riko Izumi. Tatewaku stands out in that he'sactivelytrying to get with her (contrast to other boys who've made a fanclub for her instead), but all the same he gets instantly shot down. Super Gullible: Poor boy can believe just about anything with a little push. From wearing ragged clothes because shops say they're fashionable, to wearing a skirt because his horoscope said it was his "lucky item", to all the pranks Mr. Makabe pulls, Tatewaku has it rough. Throw the Dog a Bone: He once gets picked up by a gang of pirates, made to swab the deck and do all the crew's chores. His time on that ship is practically the one and only time peoplerespectTatewaku, since he does his chores so well and charms the crew members so thoroughly that they decide to make him captain.

characters.name: Obaba/Granny
characters.description: Brains and Brawn: WithHotakaback in high school. Where Obaba commanded authority over the school by beating up any threat,Hotakadid the paperwork and heavy lifting that allowed the school to stay peaceful. Cranky Landlord: She is the owner of Sweet Olive Manor. While she's decent to people who don't get in her way, she'slividwhen someone doesn't pay their dues. She and Nagumo become fierce rivals over the course of the manga. Demoted to Extra: The anime hardly includes her at all aside from cameos. Evil Old Folks: She's a cantankerous old biddy, we'll tell you that. Anybody in her way gets reduced to dust, save for the ever-resilient Nagumo. In the final major arc, she runs for mayor to make a paradise for the elderly at the expense of everyone else. Never Mess with Granny: Obaba, over her long life, picked up some impressive martial arts skills, and never misses an opportunity to demonstrate them to anyone who crosses her.

characters.name: Dr. Adatara
characters.description: Butt-Monkey: On the receiving end of several pranks by Tsurubishi and his friends. No Name Given: He is only called Dr. Adatara by his family and friends.

characters.name: Tatsuta Adatara
characters.description: Career-Ending Injury: The story makes multiple mentions of his previous soccer career, but a nasty knee injury kept him away from sports. It's since healed, and he's capable of decent physical exertion, but he's not what he used to be. Chick Magnet: Confirmed suitors are Tanabe (who rigged awhole racejust to ask him out) and Shia (who he dismisses asJust a Kid).

characters.name: Ryouta Adatara
characters.description: The Ace: He's good at pretty much everything. His grades are great, his skills are diverse, and everyone in class loves him. That doesn't stop him from getting punished with the rest of his class when they all screw up. Perpetual Smiler: His default expression is aconfident smirk, which isn't unwarranted consideringhow good he is at everything he does. Red Baron: He's known among his classmates as "modern-dayWilliam Tell" for his excellent aim with anything he throws. Amusingly, they still use this name for him when he demonstrates skill in an area that doesn't involve throwing anything.

characters.name: Umi & Sora Adatara
characters.description: Always Identical Twins: From their hair to their outfits, Umi and Sora always look the same. This changes only slightly when Sora gets her hair cut. Annoying Younger Sibling: They're real brats to Tatsuta sometimes. They pester him in the middle of work and ask him to go out of his way to transport them places. Brains and Brawn: Umi is the smarter twin, as she excels in school and gets fantastic grades. Sora, on the other hand, is the stronger of the two and does well in PE while her grades areabysmal. Gum in Hair: During a contest to prove which twin is which, Sora blows the bigger bubble from a piece of bubblegum but gets it all over her hair when it pops. She gets a haircut, thereby finally distinguishing her from Umi...but gets mistaken for Umi anyway. History with Celebrity: Both of them are friends and fans of Shia, since their older sister Kamome works as Shia's agent. Their initial looks were because they were copying Shia's appearance.

characters.name: Editor in Chief
characters.description: Living Legend:He used to be a wildly famous mangaka in his youth, but has since retired and isn't interested in pursuing the field again. The old and weathered manuscripts he casually gives away can fetch for millions of yen.

characters.name: Todoroki
characters.description: Ascended Fanboy: He was already a huge fan of Kamaboko Oni, and he now works as an editor at the magazine Oni's work is published in.

characters.name: Kamaboko Oni
characters.description: Artsy Beret: He's a manga artist who frequently wears a red beret. The Cynic:Mr. Bummerhas to come from a place of negativity, after all. Despite being a decently respected mangaka and making a successful long-running newspaper strip, Kama-Oni is astonishingly pessimistic. He pretty much gives up when he can't find an immediate solution, folds when he hears that the uber popular Daisuke Naganohara will be taking over his slot inCITY Weekly, and a good chunk of his time is spent crying in despair. Non-Standard Character Design: The way his facial features are drawn more closely resemble characters from older gag manga that were first published during the 60s and 70s, such asOsomatsu-kun. Fittingly, his main workMr. Bummeris drawn in the style of manga from those decades. Prone to Tears: He's frequently teary-eyed and is easily prone to crying due to his pessimistic attitude. Respected by the Respected: Kama-Oni has a lot of fans despite his pessimism, but what surprises him the most is the fact thatDaisuke Naganohara herselfis a huge fan ofMr. Bummer, and she decided to publish her works inCITY Magazineprecisely because someone she respected currently worked there.

characters.name: Daisuke Naganohara
characters.description: He Who Must Not Be Seen: Naganohara never makes any major appearances in person throughout the story, but on the rare occasion when theyareseen, it's always from the back. One of the full cast images shows Naganohara to have long blue hair,matching Mio's appearances in theNichijouFlash Forwards.She makes her first full appearance in theCITYarc, where she, unsurprisingly, looks exactly like a grown up Mio. Legendary in the Sequel: At least through this series, we learn thatMio's humble origins as an amateur mangaka bear fruit in adulthood. Moustache de Plume:Daisuke is a common boys' name, and Naganohara uses very masculine sounding kanji. Both conceal that it's a girl writing raunchy and melodramatic Boys Love manga. Samus Is a Girl:TheCITYarc reveals Naganohara is a woman, and according to Kamaboko Oni sounds exactly like Wako Izumi. Those who came fromNichijouwould be able to get this reveal sooner. Yaoi Fan: Naganohara's output is mostly BL, and their most famous work is the over the top BL mangaStop!! Kiss Thief!. The manuscript they sent out to CITY Weekly was, unsurprisingly, another BL manga, but this time in the Warring States era.

characters.name: Eri "Ecchan" Amakazuri
characters.description: Cloudcuckoolander: While not as strange as Wako, she tends to fixate on rather random topics that lead to frequentSeinfeldian Conversationswith her best friend Matsuri. A flashback shows that her odd trains of thought eventually made her classmates avoid her entirely, until Matsuri decided to befriend her. Moving Angst: Ecchan's subplot is about her moving away to England at the end of the summer and her reluctance to tell Matsuri about it. Given that Matsuri is her best and oldest friend in middle school, it's understandable why she'd be so reluctant to break her heart.

characters.name: Riko Izumi
characters.description: Big Sister Worship: Any flashback we get to Riko's childhood shows her adoring Wako, even feeling bummed out when her older sister moves out of the home. Brutal Honesty: Admits to Tatewaku rather bluntly that she doesn't have feelings for him at all. Dreary Half-Lidded Eyes: The times when she's seen awake, her eyes are relaxed and half-lidded as if she's about to nod off again. Even the Girls Want Her: While it's mainly boys who are infatuated with her, other girls aren't immune to to the power of her smile either. Family Theme Naming: Wakoand RikoIzumi share at least one syllable in their given names.

characters.name: Nobuteru Tekaridake
characters.description: Friend to All Living Things: Besides working with a diverse group of animals, the wildlife and mysterious creatures of CITY adore Tekaridake. In the final arc, thetsuchinokoeven turns itself in to Tanabe to raise the funds Tekaridake would need to run for mayor, and his whole campaign platform revolves around making CITY a paradise for animals. He would have been a serious competitor for mayor if animal votes were counted as legitimate. Speaks Fluent Animal: Tekaridake can converse with all of his animal friends just fine. They don't speak on screen, however, so Tekaridake often has torepeat what they say for the fourth wall. Starving Artist: While he's an ambitious playwright, he's very poor with money management and is indebted to quite a few people. He hopes that his plays will make enough money to pay back all his remaining debts, but he never makes enough.

characters.name: Tekaridake Troupe
characters.description: Non-Human Sidekick: All of them play this role for Tekaridake.

characters.name: Mont Blanc University Archeological Research Team
characters.description: Brainy Brunette: Monoshiri is the most knowledgeable of the college trio, being able to decipher and translate ancient text on the spot and knowing how it relates to other artifacts. Gender-Equal Ensemble: Including Mrs. Makabe, the group comes down to two girls (herself and Eru) and two boys (Wakate and Monoshiri). Without her, it'sTwo Guys and a Girl. The Heart: Eru and Wakate both share the role of keeping everybody in good spirits, but Eru specifically is supposed to be the "Cheerer" of the group, complete withpom-poms.

characters.name: Rokurou Hohoemi
characters.description: Held Back in School: The final arc reveals that Hohoemi got held backsix timesbefore the events of the manga. Gondenyama corrects this and reveals it's actuallyseventimes. Exploited, surprisingly, because that means Hohoemi is officially old enough to run for mayor and promote himself as the "first student candidate" where his friends could not. Older Than He Looks: He is no taller or more mature looking than his teammates, but the City arc reveals he's exactly 25 years old. Perpetual Smiler: All of his appearances show him with a big old smile on his face, with hisEyes Always Shut.

characters.name: Officer Tanabe
characters.description: Cannot Spit It Out: She's had a crush on Tatsuta since they were both in high school, but has spent the past eighteen years simply waiting for him to ask her out and laments that he won't do so. When Hotaka suggests that it wouldn't be inappropriate forherto askhimout, the very idea shocks her. The way she structures the CITY Race is solely because she's too shy to confess to him in a straightforward manner. Nepotism: Implied. No one outright says it, but during the rollcall for mayoral candidates the newscaster mentions that Tanabe is one of two legitimate choices for mayor—but only because her family's conglomerate is so powerful that it practically runs CITY anyway. Ojou: The daughter and heiress of the biggest conglomerate in CITY, Tanabe pretty much wants for nothing and lives her life in a luxurious mansion. While she is eccentric, she's very ladylike and composed. Overly Long Name: Her full name, as revealed in the final arc, is Sumiresakurakomi Tanabe. Rich in Dollars, Poor in Sense: While she's a kind person, she's lacking in basic reasoning thanks to her rich and sheltered upbringing. For example, she has her butler kidnap people whom she thinks deserve a reward for their good deeds, and the reason why the CITY Race was structured as it was this year was because she was too shy to ask Tatsuta Adatara out on a date in a normal way.

characters.name: Hotaka
characters.description: Brains and Brawn: WithObababack in high school. WhereObabacommanded authority over the school by beating up any threat, Hotaka did the paperwork and heavy lifting that allowed the school to stay peaceful. Hyper-Competent Sidekick: For Tanabe.He also used to be this for Obaba as their school's student body vice president. The One That Got Away: Implied.Obaba, in her younger years, lamented having to get married and stay at home to help with the shop, but she said she wouldn't have minded it so much if Hotaka was the one she was betrothed to instead. Hotaka could not, regardless of their feelings, because all of his family members serve the Tanabe family and he is next in line. Obaba seems to still hold some affection for him decades later, as she offers him a seat as vice mayor with zero strings attached. Workaholic: He's so devoted to serving the Tanabe family that taking time off to relax seems outright foreign to him. Officer Tanabe gives him a month the relax himself, and he finds that he can't go even five minutes without itching for something to do.

characters.name: Magician
characters.description: Epic Fail: He suffers a domino effect of this without Nagumo or the Nice Man moving an inch.

characters.name: Shia Azumaya
characters.description: Hopeless Suitor: Shia's rather honest about her feelings for Tatsuta, but herattitudeand size completely shut her down from any true romantic pursuit, as Tatsuta thinks of her asJust a Kid. Intergenerational Friendship: She's great friends with Sora and Umi, despite her being college age and them being children. Shia often stops by the Adatara household to play with them, and vice versa for the twins. Older Than They Look: She looks about as old as Sora and Umi, but she went to high school with Wako and claims to be twenty years old. Nobody ever believes her.

characters.name: Mimineko
characters.description: Mix-and-Match Critter: He looks like a cross between a cat and a rabbit. It's later revealed that he's actually one of a rare, unnamed species of animals, and he's been trying to blend in with both cats and rabbits due to the resemblance.

characters.name: Ryo Saeba
characters.description: Ryô Saeba is the protagonist of the story and lives in the special ward of Shinjuku inTokyo. The most feared sweeper (hitman/private eye combo) in town, he's a master of hand-to-hand combat, firearms and warfare tactics. He would be almost unstoppable... if not for his only weakness: women. The Ace: Ryo is the best there is in almost anything to do with his job. Crazy shooting skills, ace driver, superhuman reflexes, and is a great fighter.Part of this is to do with the Angel Dust drug forced on him though. Ambiguously Bi: He is a regular at various gay bars (to the point that, in a pinch, the staff of one let him pretend he worked there himself), and in one occasion acted with Umibozu the same way he acts with beautiful women. Badass Longcoat: Occasionally and played with, as the coat is also badass (seeCrazy-Preparedfor why). Berserk Button:Don't make a woman cry in his presence. Just don't. Also, if you're a professional killer, don't tell him you do the same job, nor hit children or defenseless people.Being caught contrabanding weapons to countries at war or in the middle of a civil war is a surefire way to get your house trashed, your nose broken, and the police at your home.Because he participated in a brutal war himself as a child.Played for Laughswhen he's called "old" in some way (e.g. "uncle" or "father") — the result isComical Overreacting.

characters.name: Hideyuki Makimura
characters.description: Ryo's first partner in Japan, and his best friend before being killed. He's the reason Kaori works with Ryo. Berserk Button: Don't threaten Kaori in his presence, or you'll find a knife in your hand. Woe is you if you try and attack her. Beware the Nice Ones: If sufficiently provoked he can easily overpower two mafia thugs before they realize they pissed him off. Cowboy Cop: Used to be one while he was partnered with Saeko. A Death in the Limelight: He was a marginal character for most of his presence in the manga, but was the protagonist of the chapter where he was killed.

characters.name: Kaori Makimura
characters.description: Hideyuki's little sister and Ryo's current partner. She's the only thing standing between Ryo and the female clients he lusts after. A-Cup Angst: Discussed butDownplayed. Her breast circumference is a whopping89 cm(35 inin the Imperial system), but has the bad luck ofbeing compared to Saeko and Kasumi, whose breasts areeven bigger(she took Saeko relatively well, but Kasumi, who had a bigger bustat sixteen, nearly sent her into anHeroic BSoD). Action Girl: She won't hesitate to bust out the hammeror whatever's in her purseif it'll get results. Amusingly Awful Aim: It's safer to give the bad guy a gun than let Kaori have one. It is eventually revealed that the reason she's so bad is because Ryo deliberately screwed up the sights of her pistol because he didn't want her to kill anybody and "taint herself" — she is a bit better when she is able to usea rocket launcher. Aren't You Going to Ravish Me?: Starting after the first few manga volumes (the second season of the anime), she would get annoyed by Ryo's inability to get horny from her.

characters.name: Saeko Nogami
characters.description: A gorgeous police inspector who tends to give Ryo very ungrateful jobs. She's also a good friend of his, and was Hideyuki's partner when he was on the force. Action Girl: A lady cop who's capable of fighting (most often viathrowing knives). All Amazons Want Hercules:Shesaysshevowed to marry only a man stronger than herself, but knowing her it could be a way to get out of her father continuously trying to get her in anArranged Marriage. So far, the first six men who her father tried to marry her off to ended to the hospital when she "tested" them, and she wasn't interested at all in the one who actually passed the test (who fell for Kaori and then left town anyway).Could also be played straight, as her two known love interests are Ryo and Hideyuki, whoarestronger than her (or were, in Makimura's case). Shesaysshevowed to marry only a man stronger than herself, but knowing her it could be a way to get out of her father continuously trying to get her in anArranged Marriage. So far, the first six men who her father tried to marry her off to ended to the hospital when she "tested" them, and she wasn't interested at all in the one who actually passed the test (who fell for Kaori and then left town anyway). Could also be played straight, as her two known love interests are Ryo and Hideyuki, whoarestronger than her (or were, in Makimura's case).

characters.name: Reika Nogami
characters.description: Saeko's younger sister, and Ryo's neighbour. Just as sexy and manipulative as her sister, and even more overbold. Cowboy Cop: She's implied to have been one. Does Not Like Men: At the start, due the enormous line of perverts at her door. Dub Name Change: In France, her name is "Rachel Lamberti" with the exception of the French dub of.357 Magnumwhere she's referred to by her original name. Fair Cop: Was one before quitting the police.

characters.name: Umibozu a.k.a Falcon a.k.a Hayato Ijuuin
characters.description: A gigantic sweeper and the only man in Tokyo that can fight City Hunter and hope to win. Absurd Phobia: Cats. Might not seem that ridiculous at first, but he's scaredshitlesswhen Ryotrollshim by forcing a really cute kitten in his face. Always Someone Better: Ryo is considered this by virtue of besting Umibozutwice(first whenthey were fighting on opposite sides of a civil war and Ryo, under the effects ofAngel Dust, wiped out Umibozu's platoon and left him for dead, and then, during the series, when they have an epicDuel to the Deathwhere Ryo's last bullet destroys Umibozu's gun). This gets on Umibozu's nerves, as he and Ryo have absolutely no idea on who would win in a straight fight (theDuel to the Deathhad multiple interferences, so for them it doesn't count). Bald Head of Toughness: He's very bald and strong enough to bring down a tree with a single punch or casually juggle with three grown men and so tough .38 Special bullets canbarely wound him. Beta Couple: With Miki.

characters.name: Miki
characters.description: During his mercenary days, Umibozu saved a small girl and taught her to defend herself, only to run away when he realized he accidentally made her aChild Soldierin love with him. Nearly 20 years later, Miki finally found him… And succeeded in marrying him. Action Girl: Is a former mercenary. Berserk Button: Donotcall Umibozu with that name in her presence. Use his old codename Falcon or his actual name. Beta Couple: With Umibozu. Career Versus Man: Averted and shot to pieces. Literally. Miki's an ex-merc just like Umibozu and is more than happy to join him in blowing stuff up.

characters.name: Doc
characters.description: The man who introduced Ryo to the sweeper job and to perversion. Bunny-Ears Lawyer: He may be a pervert and have a sense of humour even more childish than Ryo, but he's still a very competent medic and can find or plant any information. Dirty Old Man: He once groped Kaoriwhile fainted. Everyone Calls Him "Barkeep" Knight of Cerebus: A most subtler example than the other Americans, as this will be hidden under his crazy antics and the factthe context of the events he talks about is provided only much later.

characters.name: Kasumi Aso
characters.description: APhantom Thiefwho hired Ryo to help her, first for a heist and later to avoid anArranged Marriage. She then went to work for Miki at the Cat's Eye, having been kicked out of home until she could get her heart back from Ryo (her grandmother's way to give her permission to marry her beloved Ryo). Arranged Marriage: The traditions of the Aso family require that the daughters will stop stealing and marry at age 20, with their groom chosen by the family among the best thieves around. The only way out is that the woman choose their own candidate husband that will have to prove himself better than the chosen of the family... And this for Kasumi means Ryo, even if she didn't love him (yet). Buxom Beauty Standard: She has huge breasts, especially for her age which causesA-Cup Angstin even decently sized women like Kaori. Covert Pervert: Turns out to be quite happy to get confirmation that Ryo's penis is the biggest in Shinjuku. Demoted to Extra: After her second story arc.

characters.name: Kazue Natori
characters.description: An immunologist who ended up hiring Ryo for protection from aCorrupt Corporate Executive. She later fell in love with Ryo and started working as Doc's assistant. Bee Afraid: Her late fiancee was duped into creating them, and she wants to destroy them to avenge him. Dub Name Change:In France, her name is "Christelle Martin"In the Italian dub of the TV series, her name is "Katia Natoli", the Italian dub ofShinjuku Private Eyes, however, refers to her by her original Japanese name. In France, her name is "Christelle Martin" In the Italian dub of the TV series, her name is "Katia Natoli", the Italian dub ofShinjuku Private Eyes, however, refers to her by her original Japanese name.

characters.name: Rosemary Moon
characters.description: Action Girl: She's capable of kicking ass, which she demonstrates in both story arcs where she appears. Always Someone Better: Kaori can't help but feel insecure around her, given Rosemary is Ryo's old partner who seems much more competent and knows him much better than she does. Buxom Beauty Standard: She has large breasts, which Ryo describes as "extraordinary". Defrosting Ice Queen: At first, she's hostile towards Kaori, seeing her as an inept assistant who's not worthy of Ryo, but she warms up to her after they start working together. Dislikes the New Guy: She initially disapproves of Ryo's new assistant Kaori, seeing her as too green to be a proper partner to someone like Ryo, and even attempts to scare her off by telling her of Ryo'sDark and Troubled Past. But eventually, Kaori manages to win over her respect when they work together to rescue her boyfriend.

characters.name: Sonia Field
characters.description: The daughter of Ryo's second partner in the US. She arrived in Japan to kill Ryo by hiring Umibozu for the job. I Just Want to Be Special: Wanted to be Ryo's partner, but her father and Ryo wanted her out of the criminal underworld. I Want My Beloved to Be Happy: Why she encourages Kaori to stay with Ryo. Jailbait Wait: Inverted:shewas in love with Ryo since she was a child. Punch-Clock Villain: She had her good reasons to kill Ryo. On the other hand, so did Ryo forkilling her father.

characters.name: Kenny Field
characters.description: Sonia's late father, killed by Ryo in a duel. Daddy Had a Good Reason for Abandoning You: Namely,a criminal organization wanted him to kill Ryo and threatened Sonia's life, so he challenged Ryo at a duel he knew he couldn't win. Evil Parents Want Good Kids: Not really evil, but he still wanted Sonia out of the criminal underworld, and made sure, both in his will and by telling Ryo about it, that Sonia wouldn't follow in his footsteps. Then she found out how he died... Suicide by Cop:He did have Ryo kill him...

characters.name: Mick Angel
characters.description: A friend of Ryo from Los Angeles, he's practically an American version of Ryo in both abilities, antics and perversion. Brainwashed and Crazy:After being found dying by Union Teope, Kaibara has him healed and brainwashed in a killing machine to sic on Ryo. Bunny-Ears Lawyer: Just as nuts as Ryo. The Casanova: Walks the fine line between this andHandsome Lech, but his preference for married and engaged women puts him into this category. Collective Identity: In the US City Hunter was the name for Ryo and him. He later made a bet to exclude Ryo from the name, but lost.

characters.name: The Major / Shin Kaibara
characters.description: Abusive Parent: He used hisadopted sonas test subject of Angel Dust! Bad Boss: Seriously,firebrandingyour men when they fail their job?! Death Seeker:In the back of his mind he hopes he'll get killed and stopped. The Dreaded: He can terrify Ryo and Umibozu, and Mick preferred killing Ryo to facing his wrath. Face–Heel Turn: Was once a freedom fighter, until the war hit his psyche a little too much...

characters.name: The General
characters.description: The leader of the Union's army, and their strongest fighter. Adaptation Distillation: One of only two Union Teope characters to appear in the anime, killing Hideyuki in place of an Angel Dust addict. He also gets anExpywhen Red Pegasus tries to recover. Arm Cannon: He has an assault rifle with grenade launcher in place of his right forearm, throwing knives hidden under the rifle mount, and abigger grenade launcher in the thigh. Berserk Button: He likes beautiful things over anything, and his jewel shop and art collection over that, and absolutelyhatespigs.To throw him off and make him an easier target, Ryo demolished his jewel shop and filled it with pigs, fed the jewels to the pigs, and as he was assessing the damage there destroyed his art collection and vandalized his home. Humiliation Conga: Ryo first revealed that his jewelry sold stolen jewels, then devastated it and fed his jewels to pigs (hehatespigs), then destroyed his art collection, and finally stole from under his nose a crapload of money he was supposed to give to the Union. After the latter, Kaibarafirebranded him and gave him 24 hours to kill Ryo before sicking the whole Union on him.

characters.name: The Baron
characters.description: Card Sharp: He plays in his own casino and cheats at the roulette. Ryo got his attention by out-cheating him. Oh, Crap!: Had a magnificent one when Ryo presented himself. Then he died from the poison Ryo injected into him when they shook hands.

characters.name: Silky Club's director
characters.description: Faux Affably Evil: He tries to give this impression, and fails utterly. It's Personal: Ryo went out for him first because he had Hideyuki killed.

characters.name: Silver Fox
characters.description: A professional killer with a long hisstory with Ryo (mostly offscreen). We met him when he tried to kill Ryo's charge and when he decided to kill Kaori in revenge for being humiliated by Ryo. Bring My Brown Pants: In his first appearance he's defeated when Ryo fools him into pissing himself and has an accomplice take a picture of him. Butt-Monkey: While competent, he'sreallyunlucky and the butt of some of the craziest jokes of the series. Fingore: He's defeated for good when Ryo shoots off his index finger, preventing him from ever firing a gun again. Good Guns, Bad Guns:Subverted: he may be a villain, but uses what should be guns for good guys.

characters.name: Unryu chief
characters.description: Know When to Fold 'Em: He knows better than to mess with City Hunter, and is rather quick to give up the moment he realizes he's being dragged in just that situation. Mugging the Monster: People involved with him have the habit of picking fights with City Hunter without knowing who they're dealing with. Oh, Crap!: Pulled a very epic one upon recognizing Ryo, and an even bigger one when they met again. Oh, No... Not Again!: His reaction to Ryo visiting his home. Papa Wolf: First appeared to try and avenge his son being continuously beaten up by Ryo.Of course he still didn't know it was Ryo...

characters.name: The Bat
characters.description: Animal Motifs: The bat. And to drive it home, has a bat drawn on the gun he uses in his first appearance, goes drinking in the Bat Shot Bar, and looks like a vampire. Combat Pragmatist: Never forgets to rig the situation to his advantage, even handing Ryo an empty gun for their duel when Ryo proposes they exchange guns. Humiliation Conga: In both his appearances:When he first appears Ryo shoots his hand to stop him, and when he's trying to escape in a plane Ryo appears and shoots him in the shoulderleft-handed.In his second appearance he gets the duel with Ryo he broke out of jail for, a duel he rigged when Ryo proposed they exchanged guns by handing him an empty one, but Ryohits him with the empty gun right between the eyes faster than he could draw, breaking his glasses in the process, then, when he tries to fight on, Ryo shoots his hand with Umibozu's gun (a.44 Magnum), then he gets knocked down by Kaori, and finally Umibozu, pissed off for having been made a fool of previously, grabs him and says he'll bring him back to jail afterthanking him. When he first appears Ryo shoots his hand to stop him, and when he's trying to escape in a plane Ryo appears and shoots him in the shoulderleft-handed. In his second appearance he gets the duel with Ryo he broke out of jail for, a duel he rigged when Ryo proposed they exchanged guns by handing him an empty one, but Ryohits him with the empty gun right between the eyes faster than he could draw, breaking his glasses in the process, then, when he tries to fight on, Ryo shoots his hand with Umibozu's gun (a.44 Magnum), then he gets knocked down by Kaori, and finally Umibozu, pissed off for having been made a fool of previously, grabs him and says he'll bring him back to jail afterthanking him.

characters.name: Sayaka Ryujin
characters.description: Daughter of a Yakuza boss. Ryo was hired to guard her from a biker gang. Abhorrent Admirer: She becomes one for Ryo. The abhorrent part exists only because she's a minor, no matter how sexy she is. And Now You Must Marry Me: Gender-inverted example:shetried to force Ryo to marry her by moving in his apartment (getting mistaken for Kaori's wife in the process). Arranged Marriage: She is in one with the son of another Yakuza boss. Given her fiancee is a moron, she's not thrilled. Only Sane Woman: Her father is an half-crazy yakuza boss who is not above ogling on her or trying to set her with Ryo, Ryo and Kaori antics are already known, her fiancee is a shortBig Bad Wannabefixated withbiker gangsand using a muscolar lookalike to try and impress people (even those who know how he really looks like. His antics causedRyoto get embarrassed)... Can you blame her for being on a short fuse andfacepalmingalmost constantly?

characters.name: Sayuri Tachiki
characters.description: Kaori's biological sister, who searched for her for years. Doesn't Like Guns: And doesn't like Kaori using them either. Hyperspace Mallet: How Ryo accepted her identity as Kaori's sister; she malletted him. Intrepid Reporter: Director of Weekly News, she has no qualms at inquiring over corrupted politicians, and will calmly destroy letters of threat without even opening them if they aren't grammatically perfect. Shared Family Quirks: At first glance, Roy couldn’t believe someone as beautiful and graceful-looking as Sayuri could be Kaori’s biological sister, until he tries to put the moves on her did she responded with aHyperspace Mallet.

characters.name: Police superintendent-general Nogami
characters.description: The chief of the Tokyo Metropolitan Police. Also Saeko's father, and an embarrassment for his daughters. Amazingly Embarrassing Parent: Andhow! Bumbling Dad: No matter how serious he tries to be and regardless of the topic(s) at hand, his antics only end up embarrassing his daughters, most often Saeko. Heir Club for Men: The reason he hasfive daughtersand isobsessed with having grandchildrenis that he can't father a male child. Hypocritical Humor: He insists on having Saeko address him as "inspector general" instead of "dad" in the police office in an attempt to keep work and personal issues separate, but he spends more time at work talking to Saeko about getting her a fiancee/husband than anything that's remotely "work-related".

characters.name: Hirotaka Kitao
characters.description: Accidental Pervert: Saeko keeps her knives on the thigh, and called him out forputting an hand under her skirt and caressing her thigh in the process without her realizing. Arranged Marriage: Police superintendent Nogami tried to set him with Saeko, but he left at the end of his arc. Identical Stranger: Clothing aside, he's identical to Hideyuki, to the point Kaori's reaction at seeing him was to hug him and calling him brother. On the other hand, the personalities are very different, andRyo saw this immediately. It's Personal: Hates hitmen because one of them killed his older brother (a cop himself), and hates City Hunter becausemost hitmen consider him a role model and a goal to defeat. Sympathetic Inspector Antagonist: Well, he's hunting Ryo because he's a criminal. In the end, when he realizes Ryo is good to some extent, he lets him go.

characters.name: Yuka Nogami
characters.description: Fille Fatale: Still too young to be aFemme Fatalelike her older sister, but already drop-dead gorgeous and manipulative. Oh, No... Not Again!: Ryo's reaction to her: he knew perfectly what was about to happen. Happens again when she reveals she has two younger twinsandher father is still trying to have (male) children. Pen Name: As a novelist she goes by Yuka Kitano. Shipper on Deck: ShipsRyoXKaoribecause not only do they act as an old married couple already (to the point she initially thoght they were one), but she plans to write a novel with protagonists based on them and her readers would want them married. Smug Snake: Still too inexperienced to be aManipulative Bastardlike her older sisters, but she still can force Ryo to let her live there by hiring him through Kaori.

characters.name: Eri Kitahara
characters.description: A high school friend of Kaori, now a famous fashion designer. Cloudcuckoo Lander: If it's not about fashion, she is unable to care. Landed her in big trouble when she accidentally entered in possession of a microfilm with the formula of a chemical weapon and used its drawing todecorate a swimsuit. I Want My Beloved to Be Happy: After falling for Ryo, she decides to try and get him with Kaori because she realized their feelings and knows Kaori enough to see through her denial. Old Shame: In-Universe. Near the end of her story arc she decides to create a coat inspired to Ryo'sBadass Longcoatandthe weapons and other needed items he hides in itand make it elegant by using the weapons as decoration, but it's so ridiculous she's embarrassed by it in the very following chapter. Only Known by Their Nickname: Eri Kitahara is her professional name. Her actual first name (mentioned by Kaori) is Eriko, but her real family name remains unknown.

characters.name: Miyuki Kobayashi
characters.description: A freelance courier for criminals: as long as the money is good, she'll transport anything and anyone (well,almostanything and anyone). She hires City Hunter as a bodyguard after being attacked by unknown criminals. Dark and Troubled Past: Had to killher own father. And she waseight. Death by Origin Story: Her parents' deaths are the reason for her hate of drugs. Drives Like Crazy: Seriously, don't get in aCar Chaseagainst her. Even Evil Has Standards: Won't transport drugs or people and things involved in murders. Also, the one time she was hired by a nuclear plant to dispose of radioactive waste she left it at the door of a police precint, and her 'ethics' impose her to deliver her package or message only to the specified recipient.

characters.name: Kreutz
characters.description: Armies Are Evil:Subverted:heand his men are soldiers, but their coup is defeated by soldiers from the same army. Ascended Extra: In ''City Hunter Rebirthhis influence is felt much earlier, as he's involved in a drug trafficking operation (and possibly Union Teope) foiled by Ryo and Umibozu and his underlings actually pose a threat to them. Combat Pragmatist: His direct intervention in the series starts with one of his soldiersshooting Miki on her wedding day to distract Umibozu and Ryo from the group that kidnaps Kaori. Final Boss: The last enemy of the series. Also literally, as he's the last guy to be taken down. General Ripper: He originally intends to have the president of Latoania assassinated through hired assassins in order to take over the nation. After Ryo thwarts his assassins and he is forced into exile following his failed coup, he decides to head to Japan to eliminate Ryo personally forRevenge.
